Download places its contents at proofs/runtime; --runtime proofs/runtime/runtime therefore makes runtime.parent point exactly to proofs/runtime, where return-recovery.log and wisps.log are located.

The new reader requires real regular files, strict UTF8, one exact engine banner and one exact result marker, rejects reported engine/probe failures or timeout, and verifies each log stays byte-identical during validation.

Both log sizes/hashes and gate counts are included in additional_native_regressions in C4-DELIVERY-FACTS.json. Exact originals are copied into audit/native-additional and verified against the original records after staging.

Both new step labels exactly match workflow names and are mandatory completed SUCCESS steps; missing/duplicated/skipped steps remain rejected. Existing six completed business jobs and the in-progress read-only bundle phase remain unchanged.

Tests add missing/duplicate steps; empty/missing/duplicate markers; wrong engine; error/timeout/invalid UTF8; absent/directory/symlink logs; and byte-identical audit copies. Reviewed as source only, not executed.
